name: wardmote
description: Review your team, delegate work and retrieve durable results in Wardmote.

interface.shortDescription: Your persistent team behind your assistant.
interface.longDescription: Use your Wardmote team as yourself. Review tasks, delegate work to agents, add feedback and retrieve documents. Delegation can start autonomous work using your team's configured execution capacity and budget.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my Wardmote team and show what needs my attention.
